Spec 05 Hack Codes (Godot) — semantic diff

Branch feature/godot-mvpBase 94ba207 (spec 05 plan)Head b0bdc6d Target main (one pull request at the end of the run)Date 2026-11-21 Commits 9Files 67 · +13446 / −140 Written by REVIEW: + CODE REVIEW: · Claude Opus 5.5

Summary

Spec 05 brings hack codes to the Godot game. A Hack button on home opens a screen where a code is typed or scanned; the existing FastAPI server checks it, and the three hacks (unlimited credits, unlock everything, power 22) change what home, the fighter list and the fighter screen show. The active hacks are the first data the Godot game saves. A QR page draws a QR code per hack with a GDScript encoder; in the browser the camera scans with jsQR. A small standard-library proxy serves the web export with /api at the same address, also over https. server/ and ui/ are unchanged.

  • All statements S1–S15 have code; 172 GUT tests pass (61 new) and lint is clean. The QR encoder matches segno bit for bit on four references.
  • Hack effects are computed from the list of active ids, so turning hacks off restores the normal rules exactly (D4).
  • The game never calls the network in tests (fake_responder), and the proxy answers 502 when the server is down (checked again here).
  • QR codes made on localhost cannot open the game on a phone (finding 1); a failed save is silent (finding 2).
  • The device play-test (iPad and phone over -Https) stays with the author (Deferred Items).

Recommendation: Approve with follow-ups. Nothing is Blocking. Fix findings 2, 3, 5, 7 and 8 at CLOSE; findings 1 and 4 need a plan decision; finding 6 goes to spec 14.

Spec context

2026_11_21_05_hack_codes_spec.md (#29): statements S0–S15; Steps 1–9 (all ✅); decisions D1–D12.

Semantic diff

Why: Hack codes are what makes Hack star different from Brawl Stars: a secret code or a QR code gives unlimited credits, every fighter unlocked, or power levels up to 22. Spec 05 brings them to the Godot game with the existing FastAPI server (shared codes), the first save file (the active hacks), a QR page to print, camera scanning in the browser, and the local web setup that serves the export with the server's /api at the same address.

Breaking: none · Checks: 7 pass · 2 n/a · 0 fail

Screens: real screenshots from a windowed Godot 4.7.2 run (a temporary capture script, removed), with HackServer.fake_responder answering like the server. Before comes from a temporary worktree at 94ba207. Outputs come from a temporary headless script; the proxy from the real server and serve_web.py with curl.

Author Q&A

Why does the Godot game call the Python server instead of checking codes itself?
D1 and spec 03: one server for both games so they share the codes; the codes are not written in the Godot code. server/ and ui/ are unchanged (git diff is empty there).
Can a hack corrupt progress?
No. D4: effects are computed from active_hacks at read time; trophies, unlocks and power levels are never written. Turning all hacks off only clears the list (S9).
Why a GDScript QR encoder and a JavaScript decoder?
D10: drawing a QR code needs no library and works headless for the tests (checked bit for bit against segno). D8: Godot has no camera QR decoder and Safari has no BarcodeDetector, so jsQR runs in the page with an HTML video overlay, as in the Svelte game.
How does the phone reach the server?
D3: serve_web.ps1 serves the export and forwards /api to the server on this computer, so the page's own origin + /api works on the Wi-Fi too; -Https adds a self-signed certificate because the camera needs https:// away from localhost.

Previously reviewed

2026-11-21 · spec 04 (same branch, head 5585efb) covered spec 04's range only. In this range some of its hunks change again: scenes/autoload/game_state.gd (active hacks, save file, start code), scenes/home.gd (Hack button, credits, start code), scenes/autoload/screens.gd (two screens), tests/test_screen_sizes.gd and the power texts of the card and the fighter screen. Highlights

1 · Server client: three outcomes for the screen

hack_star_godot/scenes/autoload/hack_server.gd:29-46 · e3653ed · Step 2 · S2, S7, S11, S13 · D1, D2

29## Checks a code. `ok` has `id`, `name` and `code` of the hack.
30func redeem(code: String) -> Dictionary:
31 var body: String = JSON.stringify({"code": Hacks.normalize_code(code)})
32 var answer: Dictionary = await _requestawait — Suspends the function until the coroutine or signal completes. redeem() can be awaited by the screen while HTTPRequest runs, without blocking frames.(HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, "/hacks/redeem", body)
33 var status: int = answer["status"]
34 if status == 404:
35 return {"status": STATUS_UNKNOWN}
36 if status != 200:
37 return {"status": STATUS_NO_SERVER}
38 var parsed: Variant = _parse(answer["body"])
39 if not parsed is Dictionary:
40 return {"status": STATUS_NO_SERVER}
41 var hack: Dictionary = _known_hack(parsed)Allow-list of hack ids — Only the three ids of S11 are accepted. A 200 for hypercharge or creator (later specs) becomes 'unknown', so the server's later codes do nothing yet (D1).
42 if hack.is_empty():
43 return {"status": STATUS_UNKNOWN}
44 hack["status"] = STATUS_OK
45 return hack
46

What changed: redeem() sends the normalised code and folds every answer into ok / unknown / no_server. Why it matters: This is the only contract between the Godot game and the shared server; the screen trusts it. Check: 404 and an unknown id are 'unknown'; every other status is 'no_server' (finding 4: a 422 too).

2 · Test seam and the real HTTP request

hack_star_godot/scenes/autoload/hack_server.gd:86-104 · e3653ed · Step 2 · S13 · D2

86# The answer as `{"status": int, "body": String}`; status 0 when nothing came back.
87func _request(method: HTTPClient.Method, path: String, body: String) -> Dictionary:
88 var url: String = base_url() + path
89 if fake_responder.is_valid()Callable — A reference to a function or lambda. An empty Callable is invalid, so is_valid() tells whether a test installed a fake answer.:
90 var method_name: String = "POST" if method == HTTPClient.METHOD_POST else "GET"
91 var fake: Dictionary = await fake_responder.call(method_name, url, body)
92 return fake
93 var http: HTTPRequest = HTTPRequest.new()
94 http.timeoutHTTPRequest.timeout — Seconds before the request fails with RESULT_TIMEOUT. 8 s (D2) turns a hanging server into the 'no_server' outcome. = TIMEOUT_SECONDS
95 add_child(http)
96 var headers: PackedStringArray = ["Content-Type: application/json"]
97 if http.request(url, headers, method, body) != OK:
98 http.queue_free()
99 return {"status": 0, "body": ""}
100 var response: Array = await http.request_completed
101 http.queue_free()
102 if response[0] != HTTPRequest.RESULT_SUCCESS:
103 return {"status": 0, "body": ""}
104 return {"status": response[1], "body": (response[3] as PackedByteArray).get_string_from_utf8()}

What changed: A Callable replaces the network in tests; otherwise a child HTTPRequest with an 8 s timeout. Why it matters: Keeps the GUT tests offline (D2) and gives the S13 message on a timeout or no connection. Check: Every exit frees the HTTPRequest; a failed result maps to status 0.

What changed: activate_hack ignores unknown or active ids and saves; reset_hacks clears and saves. Why it matters: First saved data of the Godot game; one writer keeps the format in one place. Check: _save_hacks drops a failed open silently (finding 2).

4 · Reading the save file defensively

hack_star_godot/game/save_data.gd:14-31 · 2cd525c · Step 1 · S8 · D5

14static func from_json(text: String) -> Array[String]:
15 var result: Array[String] = []
16 var json: JSON = JSON.new()
17 if json.parse(text) != OK:
18 return result
19 var data: Variant = json.data
20 if not data is Dictionary:
21 return result
22 var version: Variant = data.get("version")
23 if not (version is int or version is floatJSON numbers in Godot — JSON.parse returns every number as float, so 1 comes back as 1.0; the check accepts both and compares int(version).) or int(version) > VERSION or int(version) < 1:
24 return result
25 var saved: Variant = data.get("hacks")
26 if not saved is Array:
27 return result
28 for hack_id: Variant in saved:
29 if hack_id is String and Hacks.is_known(hack_id)Allow-list — Only ids the game knows survive loading, so an old or edited file cannot add an effect. and not hack_id in result:
30 result.append(hack_id)
31 return result

What changed: A broken, foreign or newer file gives no hacks; unknown and repeated ids are dropped. Why it matters: A save file from spec 08 or a tampered one must never turn on a wrong hack. Check: version accepts int or float, because JSON numbers parse as float in Godot.

5 · A scanned text or a QR link becomes a code

hack_star_godot/game/hacks.gd:44-70 · 2cd525c, 741d36a, 0ec1ce8 · Steps 1, 6, 8 · S2, S3, S10 · D9

44## The code inside a scanned text: a plain code, or a link with `?hack=<CODE>`.
45static func code_from_scan(text: String) -> String:
46 var scanned: String = text.strip_edges()
47 var query_start: int = scanned.find("?")
48 if query_start < 0:
49 return normalize_code(scanned)
50 var query: String = scanned.substr(query_start + 1)
51 var fragment_start: int = query.find("#")
52 if fragment_start >= 0:
53 query = query.substr(0, fragment_start)
54 for pair: String in query.split("&"):

66
67

70 return "%s?%s=%s" % [game_address, CODE_PARAMETER, normalize_code(code).uri_encode()String.uri_encode — Percent-encodes the code for the link, so a code with special characters stays one query value.]

What changed: code_from_scan takes a plain code or the hack parameter of a link; link builds the QR text. Why it matters: Typing, the in-game scanner and the camera app all end in the same redeem. 10 · Proxy: forward /api or answer 502

hack_star_godot/tools/serve_web.py:72-109 · 420bab7 · Step 7 · S13, S15 · D3

72 def _forward(self) -> None:
73 length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
74 body = self.rfile.read(length) if length else None
75 headers = {
76 name: value
77 for name, value in self.headers.items()
78 if name.lower() not in HOP_BY_HOPHop-by-hop headers — Headers that belong to one connection (Connection, Transfer-Encoding, Upgrade...) and must not be passed on by a proxy (RFC 9110). and name.lower() != "host"
79 }
80 connection_class = http.client.HTTPSConnectionhttp.client — Python standard-library HTTP client; HTTPSConnection is used when -ApiUrl is https://. if self.api_tls else http.client.HTTPConnection
81 connection = connection_class(self.api_host, self.api_port, timeout=30)
82 try:
83 connection.request(self.command, self.path, body=body, headers=headers)
84 response = connection.getresponse()
85 payload = response.read()
86 except (OSError, http.client.HTTPException):
87 self._bad_gateway()
88 return
89 finally:
90 connection.close()
91 self.send_response(response.status, response.reason)
92 for name, value in response.getheaders():
93 if name.lower() not in HOP_BY_HOP and name.lower() != "content-length":
94 self.send_header(name, value)
95 self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
96 self.send_header("Connection", "close")
97 self.end_headers()
98 if self.command != "HEAD":
99 self.wfile.write(payload)
100
101 def _bad_gateway(self) -> None:
102 payload = json.dumps({"detail": "The hack server is not reachable"}).encode()
103 self.send_response(502, "Bad Gateway")
104 self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
105 self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
106 self.send_header("Connection", "close")
107 self.end_headers()
108 if self.command != "HEAD":
109 self.wfile.write(payload)

What changed: Each /api request is relayed with http.client; any connection failure becomes a 502 JSON answer. Why it matters: Same origin for page and server: no CORS, no server change; the game shows the S13 message on 502. Check: Hop-by-hop headers and Host are dropped; Content-Length is recomputed.

Findings

#FindingLayerClassSeverityTarget
1The QR codes link to the address the QR page is opened on (qr_page.gd:9, 36-41). Opened on this computer (localhost, and always in a desktop run) the saved or printed codes open http://localhost:8060/?hack=… on a phone, which does not reach this computer, so the camera-app way of S3 and S10 fails. The README does not tell the adult to open the QR page from the Wi-Fi addressspecspecShould-fixplan decision
2GameState._save_hacks (game_state.gd:102-106) ignores a failed FileAccess.open: the screen says “unlocked!”, but after a reload the hack is gone, with no warning anywhere (Layer 3: no swallowed errors)codeguidelineShould-fixfix now
3Back pressed while a code is checked: submit returns at hack_screen.gd:71 before GameState.activate_hack (line 76), so a code the server accepted is not activated. Activating before the tree check keeps the hackcodespecNitfix now
4HackServer.redeem (hack_server.gd:34-37) maps every status besides 200 and 404 to no_server; a 422 (a scanned plain text over the server's 100 characters) shows “Can't reach the hack server” although the server answered (record block hack-server-client). D2 says “any other status”, so changing it needs a decisioncodespecNitplan decision
5QrPage.save_image (qr_page.gd:47-49) calls save_png_to_buffer() on QrImage.image_for, which returns null when the link is too long for version 10 (a long game address); a guard that returns an empty path gives “Could not save the image.” instead of a script errorcodeguidelineNitfix now
6serve_web.py _tunnel (serve_web.py:111-113) opens a plain TCP connection even when -ApiUrl is https://, so a WebSocket to an https server would fail (plain HTTP forwarding handles TLS). It matters only for roomscodespecNitdeferred (spec 14)
7Docs: README.md:147 and docs/architecture.md:48 call the button Use (the screen says Use code); architecture.md:48 names a class HackScreen that hack_screen.gd does not declare; the heading Saved progress (planned — spec 05 / spec 08) (architecture.md:150) is stalespecdocsNitfix now
8tests/test_home.gd:96-105 and tests/test_screen_sizes.gd:214-255 reset HackServer.fake_responder at the end of the test body, not in after_each as the other hack tests do; a runtime error in such a test leaves the fake on (or off) for the following tests (D2: never the network)codetestNitfix now

Good: one autoload owns the network and one owns the file, with clear outcomes and a test seam, so the screens stay simple and the tests offline. Hack effects are derived, never stored, so a reset is exact. The save file is read defensively. The QR encoder is checked against an independent reference, including the version information. The camera overlay keeps frames out of the engine and closes when the screen goes away. The proxy needs no new package; only the certificate maker pins cryptography. Every Step's Notes record what was really checked (screenshots, jsQR read-back, a Playwright run with a fake camera), and nothing in server/ or ui/ changed.

Not covered

  • web/jsQR.js (10 108 lines) and web/jsQR-LICENSE.txt: third-party jsQR 1.4.0, unmodified (Step 8 Notes); only the licence row was checked.
  • game/qr_code.gd (419 lines) was read for structure only; its correctness rests on tests/test_qr_code.gd and the four segno fixtures in tests/fixtures/.
  • *.gd.uid files (16): Godot's generated resource ids. The .tscn layouts: container trees, checked by test_screen_sizes.gd and the screenshots.
  • tools/make_cert.py and the -Https path were not run again (Step 7 ran them); the camera and ?hack= browser run was not repeated (Step 8, Playwright).
  • The spec file, README.md and docs/architecture.md were read for agreement with the code only (finding 7).

Concepts glossary

Allow-list
Only ids the game knows survive loading, so an old or edited file cannot add an effect.
Allow-list of hack ids
Only the three ids of S11 are accepted. A 200 for hypercharge or creator (later specs) becomes 'unknown', so the server's later codes do nothing yet (D1).
Array subexpression
@(...) always yields an array, so .Count works for zero or one file in Windows PowerShell 5.1.
await
Suspends the function until the coroutine or signal completes. redeem() can be awaited by the screen while HTTPRequest runs, without blocking frames.
call_deferred
Runs the call at the end of the frame. Changing the scene from inside _ready of the current scene is not allowed directly.
Callable
A reference to a function or lambda. An empty Callable is invalid, so is_valid() tells whether a test installed a fake answer.
DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute
Creates the folder and its parents. Needed when a test points save_path to user://test/.
facingMode: environment
Asks for the back camera of a phone or iPad; desktops fall back to their only camera.
FileAccess.open
Opens a file and returns null on failure; the reason is in FileAccess.get_open_error(). In the browser user:// lives in IndexedDB.
getUserMedia
Asks the browser for the camera stream; a refusal rejects with NotAllowedError, which the scanner maps to 'denied'.
history.replaceState
Changes the address in the browser bar without loading the page again or adding a history entry.
Hop-by-hop headers
Headers that belong to one connection (Connection, Transfer-Encoding, Upgrade...) and must not be passed on by a proxy (RFC 9110).
http.client
Python standard-library HTTP client; HTTPSConnection is used when -ApiUrl is https://.
HTTPRequest.timeout
Seconds before the request fails with RESULT_TIMEOUT. 8 s (D2) turns a hanging server into the 'no_server' outcome.
JavaScriptBridge.eval
Runs JavaScript in the page of the web export and returns simple values. Only available when OS.has_feature('web').
JSON numbers in Godot
JSON.parse returns every number as float, so 1 comes back as 1.0; the check accepts both and compares int(version).
match
GDScript's pattern match; the '_' branch catches no_server and any unexpected status.
Node.is_inside_tree
False after the screen was removed from the tree, e.g. Back pressed while awaiting. Guards against touching freed labels.
String.uri_decode
Decodes percent-escapes of a URL. The code in ?hack= is decoded before it is normalised.
String.uri_encode
Percent-encodes the code for the link, so a code with special characters stays one query value.
window.isSecureContext
True on https:// and on localhost. Without it navigator.mediaDevices is undefined, so the scanner reports needs_https.
